description: This file defines a background service and an internal activity for displaying notifications in an Android application. It includes implementation for starting and stopping the service, creating notifications with PendingIntent, and a UI class for triggering notifications.

classes.name: NotificationBackgroundService
classes.description: A background service that cancels notifications when started and stops itself.

classes.name: NotificationBackgroundService.Controller
classes.description: An activity providing a UI with a button to trigger a notification that starts a background service.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles service start, cancels a notification, and stops the service.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns null as binding is not used in this service.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, setting the layout and button listener.

methods.name: showNotification
methods.description: Creates and displays a notification with a PendingIntent to start the background service.
